## AI content repurposer (article → platform drafts → approve → Sheets calendar)
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/repurpose

1. Visitor pastes an article (or a public URL; 3 fictional sample posts on the page), picks a voice and the platforms.
2. URL → fetched and stripped to the article text. **Gemini** extracts title, summary and key points and writes LinkedIn, X thread, Instagram and newsletter drafts in that voice, using only facts from the source.
3. Drafts page: every draft editable with character counts; Approve + date → row in **Google Sheets** (Content calendar tab). Private owner view.

Nothing is posted anywhere. Sources kept 7 days; successful executions not saved; 20 runs/day, 4 per connection.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline and the sample posts are fictional.
### 1 · Demo page · text or URL → Gemini writes the drafts → drafts page
### 2 · Drafts page · approve → Google Sheets content calendar · owner view
